pool.text: British captain James Cook wrote of his arrival at their anchorage place.
George Vason was an English missionary who arrived in Tonga.
The first written record for Nukuʻalofa is stated in the first dedicated book.
The second-oldest book dedicated to Tonga was published by William Mariner.
Two Tahitian London Missionaries were detained by Tupou, the chief of Nukuʻalofa.
The arrival of the Methodist missionaries reinforced the Christian faith.
The US Exploring Expedition met with King Josiah in Nukuʻalofa.
Father Chevron arrived in Nukuʻalofa and met the Tuʻi Kanokupolu.
Taufaʻahau moved his capital to Kolofoʻou after ruling from Pangai.
Takai's fortress of Pea burned down under the command of Moeakiola.
King George Taufaʻahau Tupou I issued the Constitution of Tonga.
A lack of progress towards democracy led to riots destroying the district.
Reconstruction of the central business district started, funded by China.
The Tongan Parliament House was destroyed by Cyclone Gita.
The capital city was struck by a tsunami from an eruption.
